column1: # One known violation key per row, tab-separated:
#   file, func, op, view, class, caller, max_lines, tests, verdict, note
# file/func is the production call site (closures folded into their function);
# op/view/class say what it did; caller is the nearest internal/api function that led
# there ("-" when none). max_lines caps the distinct offending lines in that
# function; tests counts the tests that reached the key in the full run.
# Verdicts: misroute (S3 fix owed), known-violation (S4 placement), relic
# (finds pre-split rows only), fixture (a test-only shape). A key not listed,
# a triage row, or a function past its line cap fails //internal/api:api_split_strict_test.
# Regenerate from a full run with scripts/split-strict-baseline, then
# adjudicate every new row by hand.
